description: Turns text (up to 1000 characters) into speech with a Cloudflare Workers AI TTS model, in English, Spanish, French or Japanese. Returns base64 audio as the model gives it. German and Turkish are not offered: the model used here does not list them. Requires the env.AI binding. Price: $0.003 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
